name: Filter.Tendsto.atBot_add_nonpos
script:
intro α M _ _ _ l f g hf hg
rw [Filter.tendsto_atBot] at hf ⊢
intro b
filter_upwards [hf b] with x hx
have h2 : f x + g x ≤ b + 0 := add_le_add hx (hg x)
rwa [add_zero] at h2

name: CategoryTheory.SemiadditiveOfBinaryBiproducts.comp_add
script:
intro C instC instZ instB X Y Z f g h
have key : ∀ (a b : Y ⟶ Z), f ≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.lift a b
    = CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.lift (f ≫ a) (f ≫ b) := by
  intro a b
  first
    | (apply CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.hom_ext <;> simp)
    | (ext <;> simp)
    | simp
have main : f ≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.lift g h ≫
      CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.desc (𝟙 Z) (𝟙 Z) =
    CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.lift (f ≫ g) (f ≫ h) ≫
      CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.desc (𝟙 Z) (𝟙 Z) := by
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Category.assoc, key]
first
  | exact main
  | simp [key]
  | simp

name: MeasurableSet.exists_isCompact_isClosed_diff_lt
script:
intro α inst μ inst1 inst2 inst3 inst4 A hA h'A ε hε
obtain ⟨K, hKA, hK, hKlt⟩ := hA.exists_isCompact_lt_add h'A hε
have hLA : closure K ⊆ A := hK.closure_subset_measurableSet hA hKA
have hLmeas : MeasurableSet (closure K) := isClosed_closure.measurableSet
have hfin : μ (closure K) ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top h'A (MeasureTheory.measure_mono hLA)
refine ⟨closure K, hLA, hK.closure, isClosed_closure, ?_⟩
have heq : μ (closure K) + μ (A \ closure K) = μ A := by
  have h1 := MeasureTheory.measure_inter_add_diff (μ := μ) A hLmeas
  rwa [Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_right hLA] at h1
have hKle : μ K ≤ μ (closure K) := MeasureTheory.measure_mono subset_closure
have key : μ (closure K) + μ (A \ closure K) < μ (closure K) + ε := by
  rw [heq]
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hKlt (add_le_add_right hKle ε)
exact (ENNReal.add_lt_add_iff_left hfin).1 key

name: Asymptotics.IsLittleOTVS.trans
script:
intro α 𝕜 E F G _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ l f g k h₁ h₂
first
  | unfold Asymptotics.IsLittleOTVS at h₁ h₂ ⊢
  | skip
intro U hU
obtain ⟨V, hV, hfg⟩ := h₁ U hU
obtain ⟨W, hW, hgk⟩ := h₂ V hV
refine ⟨W, hW, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
filter_upwards [hfg ε hε, hgk 1 (by norm_num)] with x h1 h2
refine h1.trans ?_
first
  | exact mul_le_mul_left' (by simpa using h2) _
  | (gcongr; simpa using h2)
  | (simp only [ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at h2; gcongr)
  | (simp only [ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at h2; exact mul_le_mul_left' h2 _)

name: Polynomial.splits_of_exists_multiset
script:
intro R _ f
constructor
· intro h
  first
    | exact h
    | exact h.1
    | (obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h
       exact ⟨m, hm.symm⟩)
    | (obtain ⟨c, m, hm⟩ := h
       have hM : (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) m).prod.Monic :=
         Polynomial.monic_multiset_prod_of_monic _ _ fun a _ => Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C a
       have hlc : f.leadingCoeff = c := by
         first
           | rw [hm, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul_monic hM, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_C]
           | simp [hm, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul_monic hM]
       exact ⟨m, by rw [hlc]; exact hm⟩)
    | (obtain ⟨m, c, hm⟩ := h
       have hM : (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) m).prod.Monic :=
         Polynomial.monic_multiset_prod_of_monic _ _ fun a _ => Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C a
       have hlc : f.leadingCoeff = c := by
         first
           | rw [hm, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul_monic hM, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_C]
           | simp [hm, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul_monic hM]
       exact ⟨m, by rw [hlc]; exact hm⟩)
    | simp_all [Polynomial.Splits]
· intro h
  first
    | exact h
    | exact ⟨h⟩
    | (obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h
       exact ⟨m, hm.symm⟩)
    | (obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h
       exact ⟨f.leadingCoeff, m, hm⟩)
    | (obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h
       exact ⟨m, f.leadingCoeff, hm⟩)
    | simp_all [Polynomial.Splits]

name: absorbs_iff_eventually_cobounded_mapsTo
script:
intro G₀ α _ _ _ s t
have hb : ({(0 : G₀)}ᶜ) ∈ Bornology.cobounded G₀ :=
  Bornology.isBounded_def.mp Bornology.isBounded_singleton
have h0 : ∀ᶠ c : G₀ in Bornology.cobounded G₀, c ≠ 0 := by
  filter_upwards [hb] with c hc
  simpa using hc
constructor
· intro h
  have h' : ∀ᶠ a : G₀ in Bornology.cobounded G₀, t ⊆ a • s := h
  filter_upwards [h', h0] with c hc hc0
  intro x hx
  have hx' := hc hx
  rw [Set.mem_smul_set] at hx'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hx'
  show c⁻¹ • x ∈ s
  rw [← hxy, inv_smul_smul₀ hc0]
  exact hy
· intro h
  have key : ∀ᶠ a : G₀ in Bornology.cobounded G₀, t ⊆ a • s := by
    filter_upwards [h, h0] with c hc hc0
    intro x hx
    have h2 : c • (c⁻¹ • x) ∈ c • s := Set.smul_mem_smul_set (hc hx)
    rwa [smul_inv_smul₀ hc0] at h2
  exact key

name: nsmul_lt_nsmul_left
script:
intro M _ _ _ a n m ha hnm
have hstep : ∀ x : M, x < x + a := by
  intro x
  first
    | exact lt_add_of_pos_right x ha
    | (have h2 : x + 0 < x + a := add_lt_add_left ha x; simpa using h2)
    | (have h2 : x + 0 < x + a := CovariantClass.elim (μ := fun u v => u + v) (r := fun u v => u < v) x ha; simpa using h2)
    | (have h2 : x + 0 < x + a := CovariantClass.elim x ha; simpa using h2)
have step : ∀ p : ℕ, p • a < (p + 1) • a := by
  intro p
  have h1 : (p + 1) • a = p • a + a := by rw [add_nsmul, one_nsmul]
  rw [h1]
  exact hstep (p • a)
have key : ∀ k p : ℕ, p • a < (p + k + 1) • a := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro p; simpa using step p
  | succ k ih =>
    intro p
    have h4 : p + (k + 1) + 1 = p + k + 1 + 1 := by omega
    rw [h4]
    exact lt_trans (ih p) (step (p + k + 1))
obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = n + k + 1 := ⟨m - n - 1, by omega⟩
exact key k n

name: Nat.mem_factoredNumbers'
script:
intro s m
rw [Nat.mem_factoredNumbers]
constructor
· intro h p hp hpm
  exact h.2 p (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hp, hpm, h.1⟩)
· intro h
  refine ⟨?_, fun p hp =>
    h p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp) (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp)⟩
  rintro rfl
  obtain ⟨p, hple, hp⟩ := Nat.exists_infinite_primes (s.sup id + 1)
  have h2 : id p ≤ s.sup id := Finset.le_sup (h p hp (dvd_zero p))
  simp only [id_eq] at h2
  omega

name: IsClosed.add_right_of_isCompact
script:
intro G _ _ _ s t ht hs
haveI : CompactSpace ↥s := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hs
have hD : IsClosed ((fun p : ↥s × G => p.2 - (p.1 : G)) ⁻¹' t) :=
  ht.preimage (continuous_snd.sub (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst))
have h2 : IsClosed (Prod.snd '' ((fun p : ↥s × G => p.2 - (p.1 : G)) ⁻¹' t)) :=
  isClosedMap_snd_of_compactSpace _ hD
convert h2 using 1
apply Set.Subset.antisymm
· intro x hx
  have hx' : ∃ u ∈ t, ∃ a ∈ s, u + a = x := hx
  obtain ⟨u, hu, a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx'
  have hmem : ((⟨a, ha⟩ : ↥s), u + a) ∈ ((fun p : ↥s × G => p.2 - (p.1 : G)) ⁻¹' t) := by
    show u + a - (a : G) ∈ t
    simpa using hu
  exact Set.mem_image_of_mem Prod.snd hmem
· intro x hx
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mp hx
  have h1 : p.2 - (p.1 : G) ∈ t := hp
  have h3 := Set.add_mem_add h1 p.1.2
  simpa using h3

name: CategoryTheory.Functor.mapSkeleton_obj_toSkeleton
script:
intro C instC D instD F X
have h : Nonempty ((Quotient.mk (CategoryTheory.isIsomorphicSetoid C) X).out ≅ X) :=
  Quotient.exact (Quotient.out_eq (Quotient.mk (CategoryTheory.isIsomorphicSetoid C) X))
first
  | rfl
  | exact Quotient.sound (h.map F.mapIso)
  | exact Quotient.sound (h.map fun e => F.mapIso e.symm)
  | exact (Quotient.sound (h.map F.mapIso)).symm
  | exact (Quotient.sound (h.map fun e => F.mapIso e.symm)).symm
  | simp

name: DiscreteQuotient.proj_bot_injective
script:
intro X _ _ a b h
have h2 := Quotient.exact' h
have hle : (⊥ : Setoid X) ≤ (⟨Eq, ⟨fun _ => rfl, Eq.symm, fun p q => p.trans q⟩⟩ : Setoid X) :=
  bot_le
first
  | exact hle h2
  | exact hle _ _ h2
  | exact Setoid.le_def.mp hle h2
  | simpa [Setoid.bot_def] using h2
  | simpa using h2
